reference_sets.domain: 3 fixed A17 conversion/yield reactor cases (420..590 K, 1.0..2.0 bar, single vapor phase) and 8 standard formation enthalpies; ideal-gas part of the duty after removing the PR/PR-BM residual enthalpy
reference_sets.rationale: Shared NASA7 source constants evaluated independently by Cantera; flows are exact arithmetic and duties double-precision sums, so budgets are implementation tolerances, not experimental accuracy.

reference_sets.domain: 3 ideal-gas equilibrium cases (Gibbs, water-gas shift with a 20 K approach, methanol synthesis with a correlation K; 480..560 K, 1..20 bar) and 3 isothermal kinetic cases (CSTR, catalytic plug flow with power-law and LHHW rates, constant-pressure batch with PR volume; 500..560 K, 3..6 bar); standard Gibbs energies of 7 components at 300, 450 and 600 K
reference_sets.rationale: Cantera equilibrate is converged to rtol 1e-14 and SciPy brentq/DOP853 to 1e-13; the engine converges equilibria to 1e-13 scaled constraint residuals and integrates at rtol 1e-9, so the flow budget leaves margin for the integrator; duties are sums of NASA7 enthalpies of those flows.

reference_sets.domain: 24 implementation cases (13 gas incl. 4 mixtures, 11 liquid incl. 2 mixtures; 7 expected out-of-domain) and 130 pure-component CoolProp states of 8 components (gas 200..600 K, reduced density <= 1.3 nonpolar / 0.08 polar, away from saturation; liquid 0.5..0.74 Tc, p <= 5 MPa); docs/transport-properties.md
reference_sets.rationale: Implementation budgets: double-precision evaluation of the same formulation by an independent Python implementation (pure Chung conductivity also cross-checked against chemicals 1.5.2). CoolProp budgets are declared method accuracies (model comparison against REFPROP-quality fluid-specific correlations, including the PR gas-density difference), not implementation tolerances or experimental uncertainty.

reference_sets.domain: Kerosene surrogate case of docs/pseudo-components-status.md: m-xylene/n-decane/n-dodecane (0.2/0.4/0.4 mol) as defined compounds (CoolProp 7.2.0 HEOS constants) versus pseudo-components characterised from Tb and SG; PR, 1 atm, 300..560 K; ideal-gas cp at 300..600 K
reference_sets.rationale: correlation_relative is implementation agreement with an independent plain-Python evaluation of the same correlations; the other budgets are model-comparison limits declared before the first comparison, with the two m-xylene exceedances it found recorded in the fixture instead of widening a budget. Not experimental accuracy.
